subject: Mobile Development
title: Android Without Google
description: A short lesson to help you apply Android Without Google.

hook.text: Can you run Android without any Google involvement? Yes — and billions of phones do.

buildup.text: Chinese manufacturers ship Android phones without Google services, using their own app stores.

discovery.text: Amazon's Fire tablets run a heavily modified Android without any Google apps.

twist.text: Huawei was forced to go Google-free after US sanctions. It built HarmonyOS as a replacement.

climax.text: Android's openness means Google can't prevent forks — but losing Google services hurts.

punchline.text: Android without Google works. But it's harder.

quiz.question: Why did Huawei stop using Google services?
options: US sanctions blocked Huawei from using them
